verdict.rationale: Firstbase clearly offers Delaware/US incorporation filing plus registered agent, compliance dashboard, and bookkeeping services, and community reports confirm founders can get incorporated and operational within weeks. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit mention of bylaws generation or initial board resolution/approval workflows as part of the online flow, and a community report notes friction (no refunds, slow cancellation) once formation begins. missing for 10: explicit evidence of bylaws drafting, initial board consent/approval automation, and independent confirmation these legal artifacts are generated end-to-end.
